description: This file contains the implementation of subpanel classes for SuiteCRM, including 'aSubPanel' and 'SubPanelDefinitions'. It manages the loading, configuration, and rendering of subpanels within the CRM interface, handling metadata inclusion, access control, and layout definitions.

classes.name: aSubPanel
classes.description: Represents a subpanel within the SuiteCRM interface, responsible for loading layout definitions, handling display logic, and managing subpanel data sources.

classes.name: SubPanelDefinitions
classes.description: Manages the collection of subpanel configurations for a given focus bean, including loading layout files and retrieving available subpanels with ACL checks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SubPanelDefinitions object, loading layout definitions based on focus module and optional override.

methods.name: get_available_tabs
methods.description: Returns an ordered list of all subpanel tabs that pass ACL checks, optionally including titles.

methods.name: load_subpanel
methods.description: Loads a specific subpanel by name, returning the subpanel object if display is permitted.

methods.name: open_layout_defs
methods.description: Loads subpanel layout definitions from default and custom metadata files.

methods.name: exclude_tab
methods.description: Removes a subpanel tab from the available list, returning true if successful.

methods.name: get_all_subpanels
methods.description: Retrieves all subpanels for modules in the system, optionally grouped by module.

methods.name: set_hidden_subpanels
methods.description: Stores a list of hidden subpanels in the user settings.

methods.name: get_hidden_subpanels
methods.description: Retrieves the list of hidden subpanels from user settings.
